categories.label: Bills (total, in $1,000s)
categories.hint: Bills are $5,000/$10,000/$20,000. Enter the total in thousands.

categories.label: Number of diamond cards (for $60,000 bonus)
categories.hint: Most diamond cards among survivors gets +$60,000; tie = nobody gets it.

categories.label: Wounds at end (tiebreaker only)
categories.labelVi: Số vết thương (chỉ để phá hòa)
categories.hint: Players with 3 wounds are dead and cannot win. On a money tie, most wounds wins.

tiebreakers.description: On equal money, the player with the most wounds wins
If still tied, victory is shared

notes: family: end-game-categories (loot value). Values in $1,000s. Game lasts 8 turns; only players still alive (fewer than 3 wounds) can win - dead players should be excluded by the scorer. Other loot cards (e.g. First aid kit, New Godfather token) have no score value. Expansions (More Cash 'n More Guns, Team Spirit) not modelled. Source is a rules summary, not the printed rulebook.

endCondition.description: Game ends after 8 turns; richest surviving player wins
